text: 2026年11月3日，第五届国际金融领袖投资峰会在香港举行，中国人民银行副行长邹澜出席会议并发言。 邹澜表示，中国经济发展呈现向新向优态势，持续依托扩大内需激活增长动力。中国人民银行将顺应中国金融结构的变迁趋势，推动货币政策框架逐步转型优化，为经济高质量发展营造良好的金融环境；将继续深化金融业高水平对外开放，支持香港国际金融中心建设，巩固香港离岸人民币业务枢纽地位。（中国央行网站）
text_en: On November 3, 2026, the 5th International Financial Leaders Investment Summit was held in Hong Kong. PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan attended and spoke. Zou said China's economy is showing a trend of renewal and improvement, and continues to rely on expanding domestic demand to activate growth momentum. The PBOC will adapt to changes in China's financial structure, promote the gradual transformation and optimization of the monetary policy framework, and create a favorable financial environment for high-quality economic development; it will continue to deepen high-level opening up of the financial sector, support the development of Hong Kong as an international financial center, and consolidate Hong Kong's position as an offshore RMB business hub. (PBOC website)
